about: PUW ambient overworld tile animation table (code prep code_prep_ambient_anim, 2026-11-24). Authored from the held source games: pret/pokered home/vcopy.asm + data/tilesets/tileset_headers.asm (Gen 1), pret/pokecrystal engine/tilesets/tileset_anims.asm + data/tileset_anims.asm (Gen 2). Frame graphics live under maps/tools/frames/ (build-time inputs copied from those sources). Frame descriptors: {"tile": id} = an existing atlas tile; {"roll_x"/"roll_y": px} = the cycle base tile's graphic pixel-rolled (equivalent to the sources' VRAM pattern scroll); {"image": name, "index": n} = tile n (row-major, tileset tile_size grid) of a registered frame image. tools/build_animated_tiles.gd resolves descriptors into "frames_resolved" (concrete atlas tile ids, appended rows) in the project's copy of this file; the runtime animator (PUWAmbientTileAnimator) consumes only frames_resolved. Intervals are seconds per step, derived from the sources' frame counters at 60 fps (see PREP_REPORT.md for the derivation). Cycles with a "gate" key are event-gated in the source and stay static until the named gate is wired (the animator skips them). RE-AUTHORED 2026-11-24 (production/ambient_kj_reauthor): the kanto and johto sections are re-authored against the restyled 16px layouts — scroll rolls doubled to 16px pixels, frame graphics re-rendered at 16px per tileset in each sheet's own restyle context (registry keys gsc_water_<tileset>, gsc_flower_cgb2_<tileset>, pkred_flowerN_interior), and the gsc_lava strip rebuilt as the true 4-frame strip. The sevii section is unchanged.
